title: Chapter 689
text:
Cough, I'm just kidding. My thoughts were drifting today. My writing period was even more timely than my period. I wrote more than 700 words of text. After reading it, I felt that I must have awakened some strange attribute when I was writing it. It was all strange ideas. My eyes were almost blinded by it. So I plan to adjust the outline of the subsequent plot, cut out some side plots, and simplify the direction of the subsequent plot. The main thing is to respond to the call of my brothers, to enter Version 3.0 as soon as possible so that the leeks can return.

So brothers, please let me stand up for a day. I'll adjust the plot plan during the version update period and increase the density of the plot. Gu.
